sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2025/40 on packaging and packaging waste (PPWR)
sources.supports: EU framework covering packaging minimisation, design-for-recycling, recycled-content and labelling obligations. General application starts 12 Aug 2026; many specific obligations phase in later (largely 2030). Exact articles and dates to be confirmed per obligation.

sources.title: Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 on cosmetic products
sources.supports: Cosmetic product safety and labelling obligations; relevant to packaging via labelling and product-safety assessment. Packaging-product interaction requirements to be confirmed.

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2024/825 empowering consumers for the green transition
sources.supports: Restricts generic environmental claims (e.g. 'eco-friendly') unless substantiated. Basis for claim-discipline rules in this tool. Application dates to be confirmed.
